spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (लोषति लोषयति)
1 To rob, to steal.
2 To hurt, to kill.

r. 1st cl. (लूषति)
To adorn, to decorate.
r. 10th cl. (लोषयति)
1 To hurt, to injure.
2 To steal, to rob.

m. (-भः)
An elephant in rut.
E.
रुष to be enraged, Uṇādi aff. अभच्, with लुष substituted for the root, and the vowel unchanged.
